whatsNew: Onboarding is shorter to get through, with a Skip button and a clearer order. A workout in progress is no longer lost while the app refreshes your sign in. XP and ranks are rebalanced, and Home shows your weekly streak. New players start with a set of common gear, and duplicate gear drops now pay coins. Fixes for double purchase grants and a projection graph crash.
subtitle: Gym Log, Ranks & Boss Fights
